scenario: Pluriactividad mid-year: G11's salary of 40,000 (employee SS 2,600) plus an established activity registered in March 2020, whose 2024 net was 30,000, so no minoración. Q1 and Q2 are closed: 15,000 invoiced and 3,155.10 spent to June, the 2,555.10 of six General 7 cuotas of 425.85 that TGSS charged included. The year settles on General 6, so the taxpayer paid a higher tramo than the one the estimate prices the rest of the year at (#52). The projection for July to December is 16,000 of invoices and 600 of expenses besides the cuota. Stacked on the salary the activity is taxed well above the 20 % Modelo 130 rate, so the annual return will want more, payable by 30 June 2026.

setAside.oracleRef: Arithmetic under the set-aside composition rules of #10 and #15, computed by an independent Decimal script written from those rules and the sources below, not by running the engine. Re-derived for #39 on 2026-09-27 by a new independent Decimal script, written without reading the engine, which first reproduced every earlier expected value of this golden under the earlier TGSS rule and then changed only that rule. #39 restated the actuals to a taxpayer who paid General 6 (1,500.60 to March, 3,001.20 to June), because the estimate then added back cuotas priced at the tramo it chose. #52 adds back the cuotas actually paid, stated with the actuals (cuotasSsYtd), and restores the original shape: six General 7 cuotas of 425.85 in the gastos, 1,577.55 to March with 1,277.55 of cuotas and 3,155.10 to June with 2,555.10. Re-derived for #52 on 2026-09-27 by the #48 script, which first reproduced every expected value of the 2025 goldens on main (153 values) and then took that one rule. The #52 implementer added the rule, so this re-derivation is independent of the engine's code but not of its author; the script shares no code with the engine and finds the tramo by trying each one from the top, not by the engine's iteration. Actuals are the cumulative closed quarters; the projection is spread evenly over the months after the last of them. TGSS (#39): LGSS art. 308.1.c 1.ª–3.ª (boe.es consolidated RDL 8/2015, read 2026-09-27): rendimiento computable = IRPF rendimiento neto plus the titular's own cuotas (1.ª), less 7 % gastos genéricos (2.ª, config seguridadSocial.gastosGenericos), spread over the months of alta (3.ª). The net is Modelo 100 casilla 0224 and the cuotas casilla 0186 (AEAT, Información para determinar el rendimiento neto, sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es, page updated 18 Sep 2026, read 2026-09-27); casilla 0224 is after difícil justificación (RD 439/2007 art. 30.2ª: 5 %, at most 2,000) and before every LIRPF art. 32 reduction and the other reductions Modelo 100 2025 takes after it, in casillas 0225, 0232–0234 and 0236–0237 (Anexo I, página 9), so the art. 32.3 reduction does not lower it. Casilla 0224 is the year's ingresos less its gastos, the actual ones with the cuotas charged and the projected ones with the projected cuotas, less difícil justificación, and casilla 0186 is the same cuotas: paid to June, projected after it (LGSS 1.ª: "el importe de las cuotas" of the titular). Each projected month's cuota is priced at the highest tramo consistent with the monthly figure it leads to, every tramo from General 12 down tried in turn; tarifa plana 80 for the alta month and the twelve complete calendar months after it, Ley 20/2007 art. 38 ter.1 (boe.es consolidated text, read 2026-09-26); the month of alta prorated by days of alta / 30 as MonthlyCuotaCalculator does (#7). Modelo 130: AEAT instrucciones del modelo 130 (sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es, page updated 11 Sep 2026, read 2026-09-26), casillas 01–19, and RD 439/2007 art. 30.2ª and 110 (difícil justificación in casilla 02; casilla 12 floors 07 at zero; casilla 14 = 12 − 13 may be negative; casilla 15 deducts earlier negative casilla 19 results, at most a positive casilla 14). Annual: SPEC-002 steps 1, 2, 4 and 6, LIRPF art. 19, 20, 30.2.4ª, 32.3, 56, 63 and 74, VC mínimo 6,105 (Ley 13/1997 art. 2 bis). Hold-back share (Σ 130 + gap + Σ cuotas SS) / annual ingresos, rounded up to 0.0001, where the closed months count the higher of the cuotas paid and the cuotas at the year's tramo: LGSS art. 308.1.c 3.ª–4.ª (boe.es consolidated RDL 8/2015, read 2026-09-27) tops a cotización below the cuota at the tramo's base mínima up to it, refunds one above the cuota at its base máxima down to that, and leaves one between as it is. No AEAT simulator, published example or gestor covers a set-aside estimate; this is the weakest gate. Q1 and Q2 as stated pay 1,030.27 and 1,220.26. Q3 to date: 15,000 + 16,000 × 3 / 6 = 23,000; 3,155.10 + 300 + 3 × 400.20 = 4,655.70; casilla 03 17,427.08 after 917.215 of difícil justificación; 20 % 3,485.42 − 2,250.53 = 1,234.89, no minoración, due 1–20 October. Q4 1,234.88. Σ 130 4,720.30. TGSS: paid 6 × 425.85 = 2,555.10 to June. Priced at General 6 (400.20), annual gastos 3,155.10 + 600 + 6 × 400.20 = 6,156.30, previo 24,843.70, difícil justificación 1,242.185, casilla 0224 23,601.515, plus 2,555.10 paid and 2,401.20 projected = 28,557.815, × 0.93 / 12 = 2,213.23 a month, General 6 again. Priced at General 7 (425.85) the six projected months give gastos 6,310.20, casilla 0224 23,455.31, computable 28,565.51, 2,213.83 a month, General 6, so General 7 is not consistent, nor is any tramo above it, and General 6 is the highest that is. So the year's cuotas SS are max(2,555.10 paid, 6 × 400.20 = 2,401.20 at General 6) + 2,401.20 projected = 4,956.30: General 7's base mínima of 1,356.21 lies between General 6's bases of 1,274.51 and 2,330.00 (config seguridadSocial.tramos), so TGSS neither tops the closed months up nor refunds them. Annual: 31,000 − 6,156.30 = 24,843.70, difícil justificación 1,242.185, net 23,601.515, above the 6,500 other-income cap. Salary alone 35,400, cuota 7,698.05; stacked base 59,001.515, cuota 8,238.780275 estatal + 8,555.890875 VC = 16,794.67115; the activity adds 9,096.62115, the advances cover 4,720.30, gap 4,376.32 payable by 2026-06-30 (config calendar.renta). Share (4,720.30 + 4,376.32 + 4,956.30) / 31,000 = 0.45332…, rounded up 0.4534. Due window (#40): RD 439/2007 art. 111.1 and Orden EHA/672/2007 art. 7 give 1–20 of the month, and a last day that is a Saturday, Sunday or holiday of the taxpayer's region moves to the next working day (Orden EHA/672/2007 art. 7; Ley 39/2015 art. 30.5–30.6; boe.es, read 2026-09-27); 20 October 2025 is a Monday and no holiday in the Comunitat Valenciana (BOE-A-2024-26935), so it stands. VC scale (#48): Ley 13/1997 (CV) art. 2.1 as worded by Ley 9/2022, disp. final 1.1, for periods ending from 1 January 2023 (boe.es consolidated BOE-A-1998-8202, version in force from 2023-01-01, read 2026-09-27), and the same table in the AEAT Manual práctico Renta 2025, cap. 15, Comunitat Valenciana (page updated 17 Mar 2026, read 2026-09-27): 5,530 on the first 42,000, 20 % to 52,000, 22.5 % to 62,000. Theory §4.2 has 19.9 % and 22.4 % there, rates no version of the law has.
